description:
Guitarist Mike Campbell talks about writing his music memoir, 'Heartbreaker'
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Mike Campbell wrote a memoir, "Heartbreaker," that was published in March 2025 by Da Capo Press. In the book, Campbell looks back on his life, including his early life but most intently on his time as a guitarist for Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers.

In an interview with Zach McCormick at The Current, Campbell talks about what was important in the approach to writing the book, as well as some of the lessons Campbell took away after reflecting on his life so far.

Watch Singing Resistance perform the original song "It's Okay to Change Your Mind"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singing Resistance choir perform the original song, “It’s Okay to Change Your Mind,” written by Annie Schlaefer, live in The Current studio. Members of Singing Resistance also performed this song live onstage with Brandi Carlile during Carlile’s February 21 concert, Be Human: A Concert for Minneapolis, at Target Center.
